notes: Adds missing core logic, API surface validation, testing, and integration coverage for FEAT-1.

FEAT-1-STORY-031.title: Implement vector search with taxonomy fallback
FEAT-1-STORY-031.description: Build core provider_search_service logic to execute MongoDB Atlas vector search using embeddings and fall back to NUCC taxonomy-based search when vector results are insufficient or low confidence.

FEAT-1-STORY-032.title: Implement location filtering and normalization
FEAT-1-STORY-032.description: Add location handling pipeline including FIPS-to-county mapping, city/state normalization, and multi-stage geographic filtering to ensure provider results are constrained to user-specified location.

FEAT-1-STORY-033.title: Validate API contract through FastAPI endpoint
FEAT-1-STORY-033.description: Ensure provider search is correctly exposed through FastAPI main entrypoint with request validation, response serialization, and error handling aligned to tool_router and facade outputs.

FEAT-1-STORY-034.title: Unit and integration tests for provider search pipeline
FEAT-1-STORY-034.description: Create tests covering vector search execution, taxonomy fallback behavior, specialty integration, and location filtering to validate correctness and prevent regression.
FEAT-1-STORY-034.evidence: GAP: No existing provider search test file found; must create new tests aligned with existing backend/tests patterns.

FEAT-1-STORY-035.title: Embedding integration and query expansion support
FEAT-1-STORY-035.description: Integrate embedding_client for query vectorization and optional query expansion to improve recall and ranking quality in provider search.
